options.label: Mouse sensitivity
options.help: Lower for finer aim; higher for quicker turns.

options.label: Invert vertical look
options.help: Move the mouse down to look up.

options.label: Field of view
options.help: Vertical camera angle. Wider views show more at the edges.

options.label: Landing camera dip
options.help: Brief cosmetic camera dip after hard landings.

options.label: Walking hand sway
options.help: Idle hand movement while walking. Work and attack gestures remain.

options.label: Master volume
options.help: Scales every game sound. Zero is silent.

options.label: Mute all sound
options.help: Silences all sound without changing the selected volume.

options.label: Window mode
options.help: Fullscreen uses this display's desktop resolution.

options.label: VSync
options.help: On synchronises frames with the display; Off may tear.
